entries.source: When the enchanter Razeen was cornered by Spellhunters near the Daikara mountain pass she wrapped her cloak about her and fled down a narrow ravine.  The hunters fired volley after volley of arrows at her, but by miracle or magic they all missed.  Razeen was able to escape and flee to the hidden city in the west.
entries.target: 当魔法师瑞兹恩被猎魔人在岱卡拉的山隘逼入绝境时，她用斗篷包裹着自己逃下了峡谷。猎手们接连不断地把箭射向她，但由于奇迹或是魔法，他们全部射空了。瑞兹恩得以逃生并躲进了西部的隐秘之城。

entries.source: You fix the crystal on the %s and create the %s.
entries.target: 你将水晶安装在%s上，制造了%s。

entries.source: The heart seems to absorb light when you deal darkness damage. Standing on unlit tiles, you feel stronger.
entries.target: 这颗心脏在你造成暗影伤害的时候会吸收光亮。站在未照亮的方格上，你会变得更强。

entries.source: Un'fezan's Cap
entries.target: 恩费赞之帽

entries.source: Blood drips continuously from this fell suit of iron, and dark magics churn almost visibly around it. Bloody ruin comes to those who stand against its wearer.
entries.target: 鲜血不断地从这套骇人的铁甲上滴落，几乎可以看得见黑魔法在它的周围流动。胆敢阻挡装备者的人会遭到血腥的毁灭。

entries.source: This mindstar constantly emits a low tone. Life seems to be pulled towards it.
entries.target: 这只灵晶不断地发出低鸣，你感觉到生命能量似乎在向它聚拢。

entries.source: An endless supply of arrows lay within this deep black quiver. Tiny white lights dot its surface.
entries.target: 这个深黑色的箭壶中可以源源不断地抽出箭矢，它的表面闪烁着点点微光。

entries.source: take root increasing health by 300, armor by 20, and armor hardiness by 20%% but rooting you in place for 4 turns
entries.target: 扎根，增加300点生命、20点护甲和20%护甲强度，但不能移动，持续4回合。

entries.source: absurdly large armor
entries.target: 一件大得离谱的铠甲

entries.source: Worn by a villain long forgotten, this armor was powered by the blood of thousands of innocents. Decrepit and old, the dark lord died in solitude, his dominion crumbled, his subjects gone. Only this cuirass remained, dying to finally taste fresh blood again.
entries.target: 这件胸甲属于一个早已被人遗忘的暴君，成千上万无辜死者的鲜血强化了这件铠甲。黑暗领主最终在衰老与虚弱中孤独地死去，他的统治分崩离析，他的人民四散而去。只有这件胸甲被保留了下来，渴望着再次品尝鲜血的味道。

entries.source: The secrets of death lay open to you! You are to become a Lich upon your next death!
entries.target: 死亡的秘密已向你敞开！你下一次死亡就会转生为巫妖！

entries.source:
You step out on unfamiliar grounds. You are nearly on top of one of the highest peaks you can see.
The storm is raging above your head.
entries.target:
你进入了一个不熟悉的地方。你几乎已站上视野中最高的山峰之一的峰顶。
风暴在你的头顶肆虐。

entries.source:
Hits the target with your weapon, doing %d%% damage. If the attack hits, the target is stunned for %d turns and has their bleed resistance reduced by 50%%.
The stun chance increases with your Physical Power.

#{italic}#It may not bleed, exactly, but you'll make it hurt.#{normal}#

攻击目标造成 %d%% 武器伤害。如果命中，目标被震慑 %d 回合且流血抗性降低 50%%。
震慑概率受物理强度加成。

#{italic}#或许不会出血，但绝对很疼。#{normal}#

entries.source: A rugged Halfling gardener, looking quite confused as to what he's doing here.
entries.target: 一个粗犷的半身人园丁，一脸困惑，不明白自己在这里做什么。

entries.source:
You encase yourself in a field that slows incoming projectiles by %d%%, and increases your physical resistance by %d%%.
		The effect will scale with your Spellpower.

在自身周围制造一个力场，使飞来的抛射物速度降低 %d%% ，并使你的物理抗性增加 %d%%。
		效果受法术强度加成。

entries.source: Improve your predation by learning from past hunts. You gain %0.2f accuracy and %0.2f armor penetration against foes for each foe of that type you have previously slain, to a maximum of %d accuracy and %d apr.
entries.target: 你从过去的杀戮中汲取知识，强化你猎杀的能力。你过去每杀死一个某类型的生物，对该类型的敌人就获得 %0.2f 命中和 %0.2f 护甲穿透，最多 %d 命中和 %d 护甲穿透。

entries.source: You have become a keen observer in your travels. Each kill gives you %d%% more experience.

entries.source: Your deep link with Nature allows you to reset the cooldown of %d of your wild gifts of tier %d or less.

entries.source: Maim
entries.target: 断筋

entries.source:
Grapples the target and inflicts %0.2f physical damage. If the target is already grappled, the target will be maimed as well, reducing damage by %d and global speed by 30%% for %d turns.
		The grapple effects will be based off your grapple talent, if you have it, and the damage will scale with your Physical Power.
entries.target:
抓取目标并造成 %0.2f 物理伤害。
		如果目标已被抓取，则目标会被断筋，减少 %d 伤害和 30%% 全局速度持续 %d 回合。
		抓取效果受你已有的抓取技能影响。
		受物理强度影响，伤害按比例加成。

entries.source:
You hit your target, doing %d%% damage. If your attack connects, the target is crippled for %d turns, losing %d%% melee, spellcasting and mind speed.
		The chance to land the status improves with Accuracy, and the status power improves with Cunning.
entries.target:
你打击你的目标，造成 %d%% 伤害。如果你击中了目标，目标会被致残 %d 回合，降低 %d%% 近战、施法和精神速度。
		附加异常状态的几率受命中值提升，异常状态效果受灵巧值提升。

entries.source: Remove any talent Morrigor has absorbed.
entries.target: 除去摄魂剑·莫瑞格吸收的所有技能。

entries.source: You need to ready 2 alchemist gems in your quiver to heal your golem.
entries.target: 你至少要在弹药栏内装备2枚炼金宝石，才能够修理你的傀儡。

entries.source: You need to ready 15 alchemist gems in your quiver to heal your golem.
entries.target: 你至少要在弹药栏内装备15枚炼金宝石，才能够修理你的傀儡。

entries.source: Extract magical gems from metal weapons and armours. At this skill level you can work with metals of at maximum tier %d.
entries.target: 从金属武器或护甲中提取魔法宝石。在当前技能等级下，你最多只能从材质等级 %d 的金属装备中提取宝石。

entries.source:
You learn to maintain your agility and manage your combat posture while wearing robes or light armour.  When wearing armour no heavier than leather in your main body slot, you gain %d Defense, %d%% Armour hardiness, and %d%% reduced Fatigue.
		In addition, when you step adjacent to a (visible) enemy, you use the juxtaposition to increase your total Defense by %d for 2 turns.
		The Defense bonus scales with your Dexterity.
entries.target:
你学会在身着轻甲和布甲时保持敏捷，获得 %d 闪避， %d%% 护甲强度，减少 %d%% 疲劳值。
		此外，每当你进入和（可见的）敌人相邻的位置时，你获得 %d 闪避，持续 2 回合。
		闪避受敏捷加成。

entries.source:
You mix together your munitions, leading to powerful new effects:
Incendiary - Targets struck by the explosion have their armor and saves reduced by %d for 3 turns, and your physical and fire penetration is increased by %d%%.
Venomous - Shots deal an additional %d%% weapon damage as nature in a radius %d ball, which applies numbing poison as per Exotic Munitions. This cannot occur more than once per turn.
Piercing - Shots deal %0.2f physical damage and maim the target, bleeding them for a further %0.2f physical damage over 5 turns and reducing all damage dealt by %d%%.
The physical damage dealt, armor penetration and save reduction will increase with your Physical Power.
entries.target:
混合你的弹药，造成更强力的效果：
燃烧弹- 受到爆炸袭击的目标护甲和豁免减少 %d 持续 3 回合，你的物理和火焰穿透增加 %d%%。
剧毒弹- 额外造成 %d%% 自然武器伤害，作用于半径 %d 的球形范围，并如同异种弹药一样施加麻木毒素。每回合最多生效一次。
穿甲弹- 造成 %0.2f 物理伤害并使目标断筋，在 5 回合内额外流血造成 %0.2f 物理伤害，并使其造成的所有伤害减少 %d%%。
物理伤害、护甲和豁免削减受物理强度加成。
